recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片可見密集排列、胞質豐富且呈粉紅色細顆粒狀的細胞，核圓至腎形、部分核周有淡染區，細胞邊界清楚，正常造血幾近消失，符合 APL 的切片型態。
features: Densely packed cells with abundant granular eosinophilic cytoplasm
Round to reniform nuclei, some with folded contours and perinuclear clearing
Residual megakaryocyte at periphery; normal maturing elements scant
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows a densely cellular infiltrate of cells with abundant granular eosinophilic cytoplasm, relatively distinct cell borders, and round to reniform nuclei, some with folded contours and perinuclear clearing. Normal maturing hematopoietic elements are scant, with a residual megakaryocyte at the edge of the field, and extravasated red cells are present. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia in the appropriate clinical context; MPO immunostaining and PML::RARA testing are confirmatory.

ddx.vs: Reactive hyperplasia shows a full maturation spectrum including metamyelocytes, bands, and segmented neutrophils, not a monotonous promyelocyte population.
Mast cell infiltrates are spindled or ovoid with clear cytoplasm, paratrabecular/perivascular with fibrosis, and are tryptase/CD25-positive.
Blasts in AML with maturation have scanter cytoplasm and lack the dense granular cytoplasm; PML::RARA negative.
